raw_text:
PLAN "12-week Postpartum Return (4-weeks post C-section)"
TYPE workout
VISIBILITY public

GOALS
  GOAL primary strength:
    name "Safe postpartum return to activity"

PHASES
  PHASE "Phase 1 — Weeks 0-4 post-clearance (Weeks 1-4)" (4 weeks):
    WEEK 1:
      DAY Monday training 30m "Gentle walk + mobility":
        warmup:
          walk 10m
        main straight_sets:
          standing pelvic tilts 3x10 rpe 5 rest 30 seconds
          diaphragmatic breathing 3x6 rpe 3 rest 30 seconds
          standing heel raises 3x12 rpe 5 rest 30 seconds
        cooldown:
          lying knee-to-chest 5m
      DAY Wednesday training 30m "Low-impact mobility & glute activation":
        warmup:
          walk 5m
        main straight_sets:
          glute bridge (small range) 3x10 rpe 5 rest 45 seconds
          side-lying clams (no resistance) 3x12 rpe 5 rest 30 seconds
          quadruped thoracic rotations 3x8 rpe 4 rest 30 seconds
        cooldown:
          child pose 5m
      DAY Friday training 30m "Walking + posture":
        warmup:
          walk 12m
        main straight_sets:
          wall slides 3x10 rpe 4 rest 30 seconds
          standing bandless rows (hands mimic row) 3x12 rpe 5 rest 30 seconds
          single-leg balance (assist as needed) 3x30..45s rpe 5 rest 30 seconds
        cooldown:
          diaphragmatic breathing 5m
    WEEK 2:
      DAY Monday training 30m "Progress walking + mobility":
        warmup:
          walk 12m
        main straight_sets:
          standing pelvic tilts 3x12 rpe 5 rest 30 seconds
          glute bridge (full gentle range) 3x10 rpe 5 rest 45 seconds
          marching in place 3x60s rpe 5 rest 30 seconds
        cooldown:
          supine knee hugs 5m
      DAY Wednesday training 30m "Core-safe activation & hips":
        warmup:
          walk 5m
        main straight_sets:
          bird-dog (slow, neutral core) 3x8..10 rpe 5 rest 30 seconds
          side-lying clams 3x15 rpe 5 rest 30 seconds
          wall push-ups 3x8..10 rpe 6 rest 45 seconds
        cooldown:
          child pose 5m
      DAY Friday training 30m "Walk with gentle cadence":
        warmup:
          walk 15m
        main straight_sets:
          standing heel raises 3x15 rpe 5 rest 30 seconds
          hip abduction standing 3x12 rpe 5 rest 30 seconds
          single-leg balance 3x30..45s rpe 5 rest 30 seconds
        cooldown:
          diaphragmatic breathing 5m
    WEEK 3:
      DAY Monday training 30m "Build endurance & mobility":
        warmup:
          walk 15m
        main straight_sets:
          glute bridge 3x12 rpe 6 rest 45 seconds
          bird-dog 3x10 rpe 5 rest 30 seconds
          standing marching 3x90s rpe 6 rest 30 seconds
        cooldown:
          supine knee-to-chest 5m
      DAY Wednesday training 30m "Upper body & posture":
        warmup:
          walk 5m
        main straight_sets:
          wall rows (slow) 3x12 rpe 6 rest 45 seconds
          wall push-ups 3x10 rpe 6 rest 45 seconds
          scapular squeezes 3x15 rpe 4 rest 30 seconds
        cooldown:
          thoracic rotations 5m
      DAY Friday training 30m "Mobility + balance":
        warmup:
          walk 12m
        main straight_sets:
          step touch side-to-side 3x90s rpe 5 rest 30 seconds
          single-leg balance 3x45..60s rpe 6 rest 30 seconds
          standing hip circles 3x10 rpe 4 rest 30 seconds
        cooldown:
          diaphragmatic breathing 5m
    WEEK 4:
      DAY Monday training 30m "Endurance & glute focus":
        warmup:
          walk 15m
        main straight_sets:
          glute bridge 3x15 rpe 6 rest 45 seconds
          bent-knee calf raises 3x15 rpe 5 rest 30 seconds
          bird-dog 3x12 rpe 6 rest 30 seconds
        cooldown:
          supine knee hugs 5m
      DAY Wednesday training 30m "Control & posture":
        warmup:
          walk 5m
        main straight_sets:
          wall rows 3x15 rpe 6 rest 45 seconds
          wall push-ups 3x12 rpe 6 rest 45 seconds
          pelvic tilts 3x15 rpe 5 rest 30 seconds
        cooldown:
          child pose 5m
      DAY Friday training 30m "Recover walk + mobility":
        warmup:
          walk 20m
        main straight_sets:
          heel raises 3x20 rpe 6 rest 30 seconds
          standing hip abduction 3x15 rpe 6 rest 30 seconds
          gentle dynamic hamstring stretch 3x30s rpe 4 rest 30 seconds
        cooldown:
          diaphragmatic breathing 5m

  PHASE "Phase 2 — Weeks 5-8 (gradual strengthening, avoid heavy load)" (4 weeks):
    WEEK 5:
      DAY Monday training 35m "Increased walk + bodyweight control":
        warmup:
          walk 15m
        main straight_sets:
          glute bridge progression (hold peak 2s) 3x12 rpe 6 rest 45 seconds
          bird-dog with hold 3x10 rpe 6 rest 30 seconds
          wall push-ups 3x15 rpe 6 rest 45 seconds
        cooldown:
          supine knee-to-chest 5m
      DAY Wednesday training 35m "Lower body control":
        warmup:
          walk 10m
        main straight_sets:
          split squat to chair (assisted) 3x8..10 rpe 6 rest 60 seconds
          glute bridge single-leg assist (alternating) 3x8 rpe 7 rest 45 seconds
          side-lying clams 3x20 rpe 6 rest 30 seconds
        cooldown:
          child pose 5m
      DAY Friday training 35m "Core-safe activation & balance":
        warmup:
          walk 10m
        main straight_sets:
          dead-bug (limited range) 3x8..10 rpe 6 rest 45 seconds
          single-leg balance eyes open 3x45..60s rpe 6 rest 30 seconds
          standing row mimic 3x15 rpe 6 rest 30 seconds
        cooldown:
          diaphragmatic breathing 5m
    WEEK 6:
      DAY Monday training 35m "Walk + glute strength":
        warmup:
          walk 20m
        main straight_sets:
          glute bridge with light tempo (3s ecc) 3x12 rpe 7 rest 45 seconds
          heel raises single-leg assist 3x12 rpe 7 rest 30 seconds
          bird-dog 3x12 rpe 6 rest 30 seconds
        cooldown:
          supine knee hugs 5m
      DAY Wednesday training 35m "Upper body & posture":
        warmup:
          walk 8m
        main straight_sets:
          incline (wall) rows 3x15 rpe 6 rest 45 seconds
          incline (wall) push-ups 3x12..15 rpe 7 rest 45 seconds
          scapular stability holds 3x30s rpe 6 rest 30 seconds
        cooldown:
          thoracic rotations 5m
      DAY Friday training 35m "Functional movement":
        warmup:
          walk 12m
        main straight_sets:
          sit-to-stand (slow) 3x10 rpe 7 rest 60 seconds
          lateral step-ups onto low step (assist) 3x8..10 rpe 7 rest 60 seconds
          standing hip abduction 3x15 rpe 6 rest 30 seconds
        cooldown:
          diaphragmatic breathing 5m
    WEEK 7:
      DAY Monday training 35m "Endurance + control":
        warmup:
          walk 20m
        main straight_sets:
          glute bridge 3x15 rpe 7 rest 45 seconds
          dead-bug 3x10..12 rpe 6 rest 45 seconds
          single-leg balance 3x60s rpe 6 rest 30 seconds
        cooldown:
          supine knee-to-chest 5m
      DAY Wednesday training 35m "Strengthening mobility":
        warmup:
          walk 8m
        main straight_sets:
          split squat to chair 3x10 rpe 7 rest 60 seconds
          wall rows 3x20 rpe 7 rest 45 seconds
          side plank on knees (short) 3x20..30s rpe 6 rest 30 seconds
        cooldown:
          child pose 5m
      DAY Friday training 35m "Functional & balance":
        warmup:
          walk 15m
        main straight_sets:
          step-touch dynamic 3x120s rpe 6 rest 30 seconds
          heel raises 3x20 rpe 7 rest 30 seconds
          hip hinge to chair (bodyweight) 3x10 rpe 7 rest 60 seconds
        cooldown:
          diaphragmatic breathing 5m
    WEEK 8:
      DAY Monday training 35m "Progressive control":
        warmup:
          walk 20m
        main straight_sets:
          glute bridge single-leg assist 3x10 rpe 7 rest 45 seconds
          bird-dog with reach 3x12 rpe 6 rest 30 seconds
          standing calf raises 3x20 rpe 7 rest 30 seconds
        cooldown:
          supine knee hugs 5m
      DAY Wednesday training 35m "Upper body & core-safe":
        warmup:
          walk 8m
        main straight_sets:
          incline rows 3x20 rpe 7 rest 45 seconds
          incline push-ups 3x15 rpe 7 rest 45 seconds
          diaphragmatic breathing with heel slide 3x8 rpe 5 rest 30 seconds
        cooldown:
          thoracic rotations 5m
      DAY Friday training 35m "Mobility & light strength":
        warmup:
          walk 15m
        main straight_sets:
          sit-to-stand 3x12 rpe 7 rest 60 seconds
          lateral step-ups 3x10 rpe 7 rest 60 seconds
          hip abduction standing 3x20 rpe 7 rest 30 seconds
        cooldown:
          child pose 5m

  PHASE "Phase 3 — Weeks 9-12 (preparing for heavier loads after 6-week clearance)" (4 weeks):
    WEEK 9:
      DAY Monday training 40m "Strength-ready conditioning":
        warmup:
          walk 20m
        main straight_sets:
          glute bridge with 3s hold 3x15 rpe 7 rest 45 seconds
          split squat to chair 3x12 rpe 7 rest 60 seconds
          bird-dog 3x15 rpe 6 rest 30 seconds
        cooldown:
          supine knee-to-chest 5m
      DAY Wednesday training 40m "Core-safe control & upper":
        warmup:
          walk 10m
        main straight_sets:
          dead-bug progress (slightly larger range) 3x12 rpe 7 rest 45 seconds
          incline push-ups 3x15 rpe 7 rest 45 seconds
          wall rows 3x25 rpe 7 rest 45 seconds
        cooldown:
          thoracic rotations 5m
      DAY Friday training 40m "Balance & functional":
        warmup:
          walk 20m
        main straight_sets:
          single-leg Romanian hinge to bench (assisted) 3x8..10 rpe 7 rest 60 seconds
          heel raises single-leg assist 3x12 rpe 7 rest 30 seconds
          lateral lunges to box (shallow) 3x8 rpe 7 rest 60 seconds
        cooldown:
          diaphragmatic breathing 5m
    WEEK 10:
      DAY Monday training 40m "Progressive strength":
        warmup:
          walk 20m
        main straight_sets:
          glute bridge single-leg assist 3x12 rpe 8 rest 45 seconds
          split squat 3x10 rpe 8 rest 60 seconds
          bird-dog 3x15 rpe 7 rest 30 seconds
        cooldown:
          supine knee hugs 5m
      DAY Wednesday training 40m "Upper & postural endurance":
        warmup:
          walk 10m
        main straight_sets:
          incline push-ups 3x18 rpe 8 rest 45 seconds
          wall rows 3x25 rpe 7 rest 45 seconds
          scapular hold-to-hold pulses 3x30s rpe 7 rest 30 seconds
        cooldown:
          thoracic rotations 5m
      DAY Friday training 40m "Functional strength":
        warmup:
          walk 15m
        main straight_sets:
          sit-to-stand loaded with light object (baby) 3x12 rpe 8 rest 60 seconds
          step-ups to stable height 3x10 rpe 8 rest 60 seconds
          hip hinge 3x12 rpe 7 rest 60 seconds
        cooldown:
          diaphragmatic breathing 5m
    WEEK 11:
      DAY Monday training 40m "Consolidation":
        warmup:
          walk 20m
        main straight_sets:
          glute bridge 3x20 rpe 8 rest 45 seconds
          single-leg RDL assist 3x10 rpe 8 rest 60 seconds
          dead-bug 3x15 rpe 7 rest 45 seconds
        cooldown:
          supine knee-to-chest 5m
      DAY Wednesday training 40m "Upper & core-safe progress":
        warmup:
          walk 10m
        main straight_sets:
          incline push-ups 3x20 rpe 8 rest 45 seconds
          wall rows 3x30 rpe 8 rest 45 seconds
          side plank on knees 3x30..45s rpe 7 rest 30 seconds
        cooldown:
          thoracic rotations 5m
      DAY Friday training 40m "Preparedness for heavier loads":
        warmup:
          walk 20m
        main straight_sets:
          step-ups 3x12 rpe 8 rest 60 seconds
          split squat 3x12 rpe 8 rest 60 seconds
          heel raises 3x25 rpe 8 rest 30 seconds
        cooldown:
          diaphragmatic breathing 5m
    WEEK 12:
      DAY Monday training 40m "Final conditioning":
        warmup:
          walk 20m
        main straight_sets:
          glute bridge full 3x20 rpe 8 rest 45 seconds
          bird-dog 3x15 rpe 7 rest 30 seconds
          single-leg balance 3x60..90s rpe 7 rest 30 seconds
        cooldown:
          supine knee hugs 5m
      DAY Wednesday training 40m "Upper & functional readiness":
        warmup:
          walk 10m
        main straight_sets:
          incline push-ups or negative push-ups 3x15..20 rpe 8 rest 45 seconds
          wall rows 3x30 rpe 8 rest 45 seconds
          diaphragmatic breathing with heel slide 3x10 rpe 5 rest 30 seconds
        cooldown:
          thoracic rotations 5m
      DAY Friday training 40m "Transition session — ready for next phase":
        warmup:
          walk 20m
        main straight_sets:
          sit-to-stand with light load 3x15 rpe 8 rest 60 seconds
          step-ups 3x12 rpe 8 rest 60 seconds
          glute bridge single-leg assist 3x12 rpe 8 rest 45 seconds
        cooldown:
          diaphragmatic breathing 5m
